lines.zh: 我游过虚空，身下的黑没有底。
lines.en: I swim through the void; the dark below has no floor.

lines.zh: 五米半的身子，转弯要画很大一个弧。
lines.en: Five meters of body needs a wide arc to turn.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，周身的虚空水便退开。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail pushes the void water aside.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地巡，从岛的这头到那头。
lines.en: I patrol slowly, from one end of the island to the other.

lines.zh: 同伴在我上方游，影子落在我背上。
lines.en: A companion swims above; its shadow falls on my back.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是龙蛋的颜色，深紫带光。
lines.en: My scales hold the dragon egg's color, deep purple and bright.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水草，我只能绕着岛转。
lines.en: No weeds in the void; I can only circle the island.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，可没有东西能拦我。
lines.en: I do not swim fast, but nothing can stop me.

lines.zh: 四格宽的影子先一步滑过地面。
lines.en: My four-block shadow slides over the ground ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我贴着虚空边缘，那里水最凉。
lines.en: I hug the void's rim, where the water runs coldest.

lines.zh: 我们列成一排游，像一串沉下去的灯笼。
lines.en: We swim in a row, like lanterns sinking in a line.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过岛缘，末地石掉了几块。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the island's edge; end stone crumbles off.

lines.zh: 我抬头看没有天空的地方，继续游。
lines.en: I look up at the place with no sky, and swim on.

lines.zh: 浸了数年的蛋，才养出这样的身体。
lines.en: Years of soaking made a body like this.

lines.zh: 我悬在虚空里，像一块浮着的岛。
lines.en: I hang in the void like a floating island.

lines.zh: 我的鳃一张一合，把黑水吐出去。
lines.en: My gills open and close, pushing the black water out.

lines.zh: 六十点生命在身，我从不着急。
lines.en: Sixty points of life in me; I am never in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我盯着末地石上的裂纹，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare a long time at the cracks in the end stone.

lines.zh: 龙蛋的气味还留在我鳞缝里。
lines.en: The smell of the dragon egg still clings between my scales.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，让腹侧的浅色见一见光。
lines.en: I turn over, letting the pale underside catch the light.

lines.zh: 同伴靠过来，我们的尾几乎碰到。
lines.en: A companion drifts close; our tails nearly touch.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，没有声音出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth, and no sound comes out.

lines.zh: 虚空这么大，我却只在这片水里。
lines.en: The void is vast; I keep to this one patch of water.

lines.zh: 光落在我背上，又被黑色吞掉。
lines.en: Light falls on my back and is swallowed by black.

lines.zh: 我等着一尾小鱼经过，等得忘了时间。
lines.en: I wait for a small fish to pass and lose track of time.

lines.zh: 我的鳞一片片张开，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: My scales lift, one by one, and settle again.

lines.zh: 这么久没人来钓，我有点无聊。
lines.en: No one has fished here in ages; I am a little bored.

lines.zh: 我听见虚空深处有回声，像心跳。
lines.en: Deep in the void I hear an echo, like a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 你站在岛边，还没有我的鳍高。
lines.en: You stand at the island's edge, shorter than my fin.

lines.zh: 我低下巨大的头，看清了你。
lines.en: I lower my enormous head and see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，和浸过蛋的水不同。
lines.en: Your scent is not the water that soaked the egg.

lines.zh: 我绕你半圈，四格宽的身子擦过去。
lines.en: I circle half around you, four blocks wide passing by.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在看你，谁也不让。
lines.en: You watch me, I watch you; neither looks away.

lines.zh: 你手里没有鱼竿，我不太明白。
lines.en: There is no rod in your hand; I do not understand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你整个人还大一点。
lines.en: My eye is a little larger than your whole body.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我往前游了一格。
lines.en: You step back; I swim forward one block.

lines.zh: 那条钓线我认得，别装作没有。
lines.en: I know that fishing line; do not pretend otherwise.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，等你先动。
lines.en: I halt in the water and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很快，我的很慢。
lines.en: Your breathing is quick; mine is very slow.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，久到末地石都凉了。
lines.en: I watch you so long the end stone turns cold.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，只是有点吵。
lines.en: That did not hurt; it was merely loud.

lines.zh: 六十点血，你慢慢磨吧。
lines.en: Sixty points of health — take your time wearing it down.

lines.zh: 鳞片翻起一片，露出底下的紫。
lines.en: A scale lifts, revealing the purple beneath.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，让伤落在鳞厚处。
lines.en: I turn so the blow lands on thick scales.

lines.zh: 这点伤，还不够我转身。
lines.en: This wound is not enough to make me turn.

lines.zh: 水里的血腥味让我清醒了。
lines.en: The smell of blood in the water wakes me up.

lines.zh: 同伴退开，它们知道我要动了。
lines.en: Companions retreat; they know I am about to move.

lines.zh: 我的动作慢，可挨打时从不慌。
lines.en: I am slow, but never flustered when struck.

lines.zh: 你要是只有这点力气，就别钓我。
lines.en: If this is all your strength, do not fish for me.

lines.zh: 伤口会合上，虚空的水很冷。
lines.en: The wound will close; the void water runs cold.

lines.zh: 钓饵那么小，还不够我塞牙。
lines.en: That bait is too small to lodge between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了闻，又退了半格。
lines.en: I lean in to sniff, then back off half a block.

lines.zh: 多少年了，终于有人肯下钩。
lines.en: After all these years, someone finally casts a hook.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了一下，钩子从我齿间滑过。
lines.en: I test a bite; the hook slides between my teeth.

lines.zh: 香味顺着水过来，我的尾自己动了。
lines.en: The scent drifts through the water; my tail moves on its own.

lines.zh: 我要是咬住，你未必拉得动。
lines.en: If I take it, you may not be able to pull.

lines.zh: 这点饵，只够让我转一圈。
lines.en: This much bait only buys one circle from me.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根线，想起很多年前的事。
lines.en: I stare at the line and remember something from years ago.

lines.zh: 上钩的滋味，我记得，也怕。
lines.en: I remember how the hook feels, and I fear it.

lines.zh: 我绕饵游了两圈，才慢慢张开嘴。
lines.en: Two circles around the bait before I slowly open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞上一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a wall that moves.

lines.zh: 我四格宽的侧面，把你推回去一格。
lines.en: My four-block flank pushes you back a block.

lines.zh: 水被我们挤得乱响，我懒得让。
lines.en: The water churns between us; I cannot be bothered to yield.

lines.zh: 同伴被我撞开，回头看我一眼。
lines.en: I bump a companion aside; it looks back at me.

lines.zh: 你那么小，撞过来我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: You are so small I barely feel the impact.

lines.zh: 我的鳍扫过你，你踉跄了一下。
lines.en: My fin sweeps past you; you stumble.

lines.zh: 虚空里没什么可撞，除了彼此。
lines.en: There is little to bump in the void but each other.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，鳞片刮出响声。
lines.en: We pass close, scales scraping out a sound.

lines.zh: 我被顶得偏了方向，慢慢摆正。
lines.en: The shove turns me off course; I slowly straighten.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，让一步要花很久。
lines.en: To give way with a body this size takes a while.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，尾巴慢慢缠在一起。
lines.en: We hang side by side, tails slowly winding together.

lines.zh: 虚空里养孩子，得找一处安静的暗。
lines.en: To raise young in the void, one needs a quiet dark.

lines.zh: 我用头蹭它的侧腹，它没有躲。
lines.en: I rub my head along its flank; it does not shy away.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞叠在一起，紫得发黑。
lines.en: Our scales overlap, purple shading into black.

lines.zh: 两条五米的影子，在岛下合成一条。
lines.en: Two five-meter shadows become one beneath the island.

lines.zh: 它比我小一圈，我放慢了动作。
lines.en: It is a size smaller; I slow my movements.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块末地石打转。
lines.en: We circle the same block of end stone.

lines.zh: 这水太冷，得靠得近一点。
lines.en: The water is cold; we must stay close.

lines.zh: 蛋的年代过去很久，我们才开始。
lines.en: The age of eggs is long gone; only now do we begin.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸打在我鳃上，很轻。
lines.en: Its breath brushes my gills, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块坠落的末地石，又放下。
lines.en: I take up a fallen piece of end stone and set it down.

lines.zh: 你把桶放下，桶口小得可笑。
lines.en: You set the bucket down; its mouth is laughably small.

lines.zh: 我被装进桶里，尾巴只好盘起来。
lines.en: In the bucket, I have to coil my tail.

lines.zh: 水里漂来什么，我都想尝一尝。
lines.en: Whatever drifts by, I want a taste of it.

lines.zh: 那块鳞是我掉的，我捡了回来。
lines.en: That scale is mine; I pick it back up.

lines.zh: 桶那么浅，我一半身子在外头。
lines.en: The bucket is shallow; half of me stays outside.

lines.zh: 我用嘴拨了拨钩上的饵，没有咬。
lines.en: I nudge the bait with my snout, without biting.

lines.zh: 被装走时，我连身都转不过来。
lines.en: Carried off, I cannot even turn around.

lines.zh: 这么轻的一点，我用嘴就能托住。
lines.en: Something this light I can hold in my jaws.

lines.zh: 我叼着它游了一圈，才松口。
lines.en: I carry it one lap before letting go.

lines.zh: 水里有个影子在动，我锁住了它。
lines.en: A shadow moves in the water; I lock onto it.

lines.zh: 那条抢我食的鱼，我记住了。
lines.en: That fish that stole my food — I remember it.

lines.zh: 我转头的动作很慢，但一旦转了就定了。
lines.en: My turn is slow, but once turned, it is decided.

lines.zh: 目标不大，我正好拿来磨磨牙。
lines.en: The target is small enough to sharpen my teeth on.

lines.zh: 钓线那头的你，也算一个目标。
lines.en: You at the end of the line count as a target too.

lines.zh: 我盯上了它，就没打算放开。
lines.en: I have fixed on it and do not intend to let go.

lines.zh: 一点血的东西也敢在我面前晃。
lines.en: Something with one point of health dares drift before me.

lines.zh: 我把身子正过去，四格宽全对着它。
lines.en: I square my body, all four blocks facing it.

lines.zh: 同伴也转过头，我们看的是同一个。
lines.en: A companion turns too; we look at the same thing.

lines.zh: 虚空里安静下来，这就是开始的信号。
lines.en: The void goes quiet; that is the signal to begin.

lines.zh: 我认出了那种游法，是猎物。
lines.en: I know that way of swimming: prey.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升起，从上方压住它。
lines.en: I rise slowly and press down on it from above.

lines.zh: 六十点血的身子，不怕这点纠缠。
lines.en: Sixty points of health do not fear such a scuffle.

lines.zh: 我选定你了，别想游出这片水。
lines.en: I have chosen you; do not try to leave this water.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，一圈要游很久。
lines.en: I circle it; one lap takes a long while.

lines.zh: 我不急，虚空里的时间不值钱。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; time is cheap in the void.

lines.zh: 它转向哪边，我的头就压到哪边。
lines.en: Whichever way it turns, my head presses there.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压住它，身体随后到。
lines.en: My shadow pins it first; my body arrives after.

lines.zh: 它想钻石头缝，可那缝太窄了。
lines.en: It tries a stone gap, but the gap is too narrow.

lines.zh: 我贴着岛底靠近，不带一点水声。
lines.en: I creep along the island's underside without a sound.

lines.zh: 这么慢的逼近，比冲过去更吓人。
lines.en: This slow approach frightens more than a charge.

lines.zh: 它停住了，我也停住，等它先动。
lines.en: It stops; I stop too, waiting for it to move.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，又合上，先吓一吓。
lines.en: I open my jaws and close them, a warning first.

lines.zh: 我们绕了很久，水都被搅浑了。
lines.en: We circle so long the water turns cloudy.

lines.zh: 它每一次摆尾，我都数着。
lines.en: I count every beat of its tail.

lines.zh: 我不咬空，这一口要咬实。
lines.en: I do not bite at air; this bite will land.

lines.zh: 虚空的水没有退路，它知道的。
lines.en: The void water offers no retreat; it knows.

lines.zh: 我把圈子收到最后半格。
lines.en: I draw the circle down to its final half block.

lines.zh: 我把它和整座岛一起圈进来。
lines.en: I enclose it and the whole island together.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，水都震了一下。
lines.en: I bite down, and the water itself shudders.

lines.zh: 这一口够重，你该退开了。
lines.en: That bite was heavy; you should back off.

lines.zh: 我的牙比看上去更密，也更钝。
lines.en: My teeth are denser than they look, and blunter.

lines.zh: 它被撞得翻了个身，还没站稳。
lines.en: The blow flips it over before it can recover.

lines.zh: 五米的身子压过去，谁也受不住。
lines.en: Five meters of body pressing down — nothing withstands it.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松开，只是让你记住。
lines.en: I bite and release, only to make you remember.

lines.zh: 水花炸开，末地石上全是湿痕。
lines.en: Water bursts; wet streaks cover the end stone.

lines.zh: 我的攻击不快，但落点很准。
lines.en: My strike is not fast, but it lands true.

lines.zh: 这一下用了我半边身子的力。
lines.en: That blow spent half the strength in my body.

lines.zh: 它躲开了第一下，第二下没躲开。
lines.en: It dodged the first; the second it did not.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它整个掀了起来。
lines.en: I whip my head and throw it clean out of the water.

lines.zh: 牙关合上的声音，比雷还闷。
lines.en: My jaws closing sound duller than thunder.

lines.zh: 我不追，它自己会游回来。
lines.en: I do not chase; it will swim back on its own.

lines.zh: 打完了，我慢慢退回暗处。
lines.en: The fight done, I withdraw slowly into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从钓线那头升起，比你的船还长。
lines.en: I rise up the line, longer than your boat.

lines.zh: 数年的浸泡，终于有了这一天。
lines.en: Years of soaking finally come to this day.

lines.zh: 虚空里多了一条龙形的鱼。
lines.en: A dragon-shaped fish now swims in the void.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看见的是没有星的天。
lines.en: I open my eyes to a sky without stars.

lines.zh: 龙蛋在水里化了，长出了我。
lines.en: The dragon egg dissolved in water and grew into me.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，是从黑水里吸的。
lines.en: My first breath came out of black water.

lines.zh: 末地石在我身下，像一小块浮木。
lines.en: End stone lies beneath me like a scrap of driftwood.

lines.zh: 我落下时，水整整涨了一格。
lines.en: When I dropped in, the water rose a full block.

lines.zh: 同伴围上来，它们的鳞都很暗。
lines.en: Companions crowd near, their scales all dark.

lines.zh: 传说是别人说的，我只知道饿。
lines.en: Legend is what others say; I only know hunger.

lines.zh: 我一出现，虚空就不再那么空。
lines.en: Now that I exist, the void feels less empty.

lines.zh: 六十点血的第一次跳动，很响。
lines.en: The first beat of sixty points of health is loud.

lines.zh: 我还没学会转弯，先撞上了岛。
lines.en: I have not learned to turn yet; I hit the island.

lines.zh: 那条钓线，我会记很久。
lines.en: That fishing line I will remember for a long time.

lines.zh: 钓线绷断的那一瞬，我到了。
lines.en: The line snaps, and there I am.

lines.zh: 虚空的水第一次有了形体。
lines.en: For the first time, the void's water takes shape.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我就成了大份熟鱼。
lines.en: One burn and I become a large cooked fish.

lines.zh: 我从半空砸进水里，岛都晃了。
lines.en: I crash into the water from above; the island shakes.

lines.zh: 我在自己的水里，被水淹了。
lines.en: In my own water, I am drowning.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀我出水，又把我摔了回去。
lines.en: The blast hurls me from the water and drops me back.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进鳞缝里，很浅。
lines.en: An arrow lodges between my scales, shallow.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进鳃里，我抖了一下。
lines.en: That force seeps into my gills; I shudder.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有食，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the void; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，紫鳞全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; every purple scale lights up.

lines.zh: 我住在虚空里，却被虚空吞掉。
lines.en: I live in the void, and the void swallows me.
